description: Bulk-adds candidates from an Indeed/Meta export, as Import does: rows[] each with full_name (required) plus phone, email, source, source_external_id, hiring_round, track, salary_expectation, notes, resume_url, indeed_url. Optional source and hiring_round set defaults for every row. Each row is deduped (source id, then email, then phone), so re-importing the same export creates nothing new. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: import_candidates
title: Import recruiting candidates
